messages:
elaine_support:  FYI — customer org org_08A3 says their monthly credits dropped to 0 about 8 hours before the expected reset. They were using streaming websocket with two parallel sessions. Customer insists they only used ~25% of allowance before it hit 0. Can someone triage? :thinking:

raj_engineer:  Do we have their raw session headers or any X-Credit-* info? Also did they open multiple sockets or have lots of reconnects? Could be double-count on reconnect.

elaine_support:  Pasting the small excerpt customer provided (sanitized):

```
X-Credit-Remaining: 0
X-Credit-Consumed: 98500
X-Stream-Tokens: 98500
Session-IDs: [s-8a3-1, s-8a3-2]
Event: websocket_reconnect (count=22)
Keepalive: ping every 10s
Logs: chunk_id=453 resend=true size_bytes=512
```

glen_infra:  Interesting — we've seen an old bug where streaming keepalive bytes or resend of final delta got counted as tokens when fragments replayed. If the client reconnects quickly we might double-record the tail chunks.

sam_billing:  I'll prep a manual credit review. Please confirm billing window and whether they had a burst pool attached. If burst pool exhausted we do not auto-topup; customer can hit 0 earlier than calendar reset.

elaine_support:  Billing window: 2024-02-01 -> 2024-02-29 (customer timezone CET). They had burst pool configured (small trial). They also reported seeing 429s earlier with `Retry-After: 30`.

raj_engineer:  Repro request: can someone simulate two websockets with a short prompt stream and force reconnects? Minimal curl-ish pseudo repro for REST streaming: 

```
# pseudo: repeat small prompt and close connection mid-response to force resends
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-small","stream":true,"input":"t"}' \
    https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
  sleep 0.2
  kill -9 $! # simulate flaky client
done
```

glen_infra:  I'll run a focused test on staging with the above pattern and enable verbose accounting logs. If double-count happens, it'll show up as repeated token accounting entries for the same request_id. :eyes:

ops-bot:  billing-service created incident INC-2024-734 and linked to thread (assigned to sam_billing).

sam_billing:  Thanks. If it reproduces, we can either: 1) issue a one-off credit adjustment for org_08A3, or 2) if it's accounting bug, pause billing window until fix and revert. Need final confirmation before manual credit.

elaine_support:  I'll tell customer we're investigating and that we may provision interim credits while infra reproduces. Keeping them updated, will follow up within 24h. @sam_billing please hold off on issuing until we confirm root cause.

raj_engineer:  One more ask — can you attach the full `usage` rows for org_08A3 (timestamps and request_ids) so we can correlate duplicate request_ids? That will prove double-count vs net new usage.

elaine_support:  On it — pulling `GET /v1/admin/usage?org=org_08A3&from=2024-02-25&to=2024-02-26` and attaching to the incident once sanitized.

glen_infra:  Assigning to me to run staging repro and grep the accounting log. Will report back in this thread.

elaine_support:  Thanks everyone — customer updated.
